verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's built-in Composer assistant takes a stated goal and builds the audience, drafts content and maps the send strategy. It can also make supported changes and carry the work through with the user in control. Customer Agent separately handles order-status tasks automatically. Evidence is limited to marketing pages, and 'supported changes' hints at an unspecified scope. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Composer's delegable actions and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
